name: Ace SVC
summary: Proximity voice chat for Pumpkin servers, working with the Simple Voice Chat client mod. Waiting on the author's permission.
description:
## Proximity voice, on Pumpkin

Ace SVC is a planned Pumpkin port of the server side of **Simple Voice Chat** by Max Henkel. Players would keep using the Simple Voice Chat client mod they already have, and Pumpkin servers would speak its protocol.

- **Proximity voice**: hear players near you, quieter with distance
- **Groups**: private or open voice groups, whispering and push-to-talk, all from the client mod
- **No client changes**: the official Simple Voice Chat mod connects as usual

## Why it isn't out yet

Simple Voice Chat is **All Rights Reserved**, not open source, so a port needs its author's written permission. We've asked and haven't ported any of it yet. If Max agrees, we build it to his terms; if he says no, this listing comes down.

On the technical side Pumpkin's plugin API looks ready: plugins can bind a UDP port, talk to client mods over plugin channels and track player positions.

needs.why: Simple Voice Chat is All Rights Reserved, so translating it into a Pumpkin plugin needs its author's consent. We've asked; nothing is ported until he agrees, and we'll follow whatever terms he sets.

permissions.why: Runs the voice server: client mods send and receive audio over UDP.
